notes: Send A Stop: on a customer card, tap Send on an address to send that customer and a stop to Casey or Cody. It shows up in their notifications with Add To Route.
You get a notice when they add your stop to their route, and when they finish it.
Notifications has a Sent Stops list. Tap Cancel Stop to take one back. If it is already on their route, they choose whether to remove it.
Plain Optimize now offers Undo Optimize, and Need A Slot is written the same way everywhere.
